watches.name: United States Border Patrol Centennial Offshore Dive Watch
watches.description: SEAHOLM® is proud to partner with the United States Border Patrol to celebrate their 100th anniversary. Designed in conjunction with the U.S. Border Patrol Centennial Committee, this watch is unique and befitting of this historic anniversary. The Empire Green dial and bezel ranges from bright emerald green to near-black depending on the light. Only available to the USBP®, this watch identifies every person that wears it as part of an elite and historic group. The SEAHOLM Offshore retails for $2295. With support from our production facility in Switzerland, we are able to offer a custom designed watch for the USBP® at this special price. It is our way of saying “thank you” for a tough job, well-done. The SEAHOLM Offshore dive watch comes with our indestructible stainless-steel bracelet.

watches.name: Offshore Green
watches.description: Current Completion Time Frame: 30 Days THE SEAHOLM ® OFFSHORE DIVE WATCH - Everglades Green Most watches aren’t built for the ocean. They’re built for the idea of it. This is a real dive watch—engineered to ISO 6425. It’s tested harder, pushed further. The dial gets straight to the point. Fine linear brushing cuts across the surface, creating depth without glare. It’s clean, legible, and sharp in any light. SuperLumiNova is applied without filler. Our watches exceed ISO shock resistance standards by 400%. We source Alpha Gel from Taica in Japan—a material so effective it protects a raw egg dropped from six stories. We back it up with a pure iron cage to block magnetic interference—the most common reason finely engineered mechanical movements fail in the real world. We apply the same rigor to the visible form. 316L stainless steel. Tight tolerances. Beautiful finishing. No shortcuts. This watch will exceed your expectations.

watches.name: Stainless Steel Bracelet
watches.description: Block-Link 316L Stainless Steel Bracelet Our block-link 316L stainless steel bracelet is an emblematic part of the SEAHOLM watch experience. Designed for both strength and everyday comfort, it combines fluid movement with lasting durability. Comfort and Balance The bracelet’s weight and taper are carefully matched to our watches, creating a balanced feel on the wrist. Despite its strength and durability, it wears comfortably and remains nearly imperceptible throughout the day. Included Feature · All SEAHOLM bracelets include a diver’s extension for added versatility and fit adjustment.

watches.name: Rover Orange
watches.description: Current Completion Time Frame: 45 Days The SEAHOLM® Rover Field Watch - Upland Orange Most field watches are one-dimensional. The Rover isn’t. Built for land, water, and anything in between, it performs without compromise. The micro-etched dial is minimal yet rich in depth. Rhodium-plated sword hands and clean Super-LumiNova markers ensure clear readability in motion and changing light. Inside, Alpha Gel Theta8 from Taica (Japan) absorbs shock before it reaches the movement, while a pure iron cage provides serious anti-magnetic protection—essential in today’s environments. The 316L stainless steel case is precisely finished and rated to 200 meters. No weak points. This is rugged, defined. No excess. Just consistent performance.

watches.name: Rover White
watches.description: SEAHOLM STUDIO WORKS SEAHOLM Studio Works offers customers the opportunity to participate in the development of limited production watch projects. SEAHOLM Studio Works participants receive preferred pricing in exchange for early participation in the development process. A 50% deposit is required at the time of order. Current Completion Time Frame is 30 days. a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; } The SEAHOLM® ROVER FIELD WATCH – White is the Seaholm Studio Works version of the Rover, retaining all core features while pairing it with our interpretation of a President-style bracelet. The three-piece, semi-circular links deliver balanced weight, fluid movement, and exceptional comfort. Our upgraded design includes a brushed SEAHOLM clasp with more fine adjustment settings, thicker construction, enhanced locking mechanisms, and a reinforced diver’s extension. A President’s bracelet—refined, but built to perform.

watches.name: Flats Chronograph Watch Black
watches.description: With a seemingly infinite horizon and miles of clear blue water, no one would argue that time spent on the flats wasn’t time well spent. It’s for those days that the Flats Chronograph was designed. While most chronograph watches use the stopwatch function to determine speed, we've turned the tachymeter scale on its head and adapted the stopwatch function to judge distance. For someone on the flats or in the open expanses of the backcountry, the Flats can be used to calculate the distance of a coming storm. Built for the most extreme marine conditions, the Flats is a certified dive watch and has a 200 meter/20 ATM water rating. Comes with the SEAHOLM® Integrated Rubber Strap.
